turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the ad budget total, so I cannot give a share of the September 2026 budget. The closest figures are remaining budget at month end of 4130 EUR and ad spend of 6270 EUR for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
